query: South Korea KOSPI foreign investor net buy/sell value weekly latest June 2026, recent trend in trillion won
answer:
I've completed the research on KOSPI foreign investor net buy/sell flows. Here's the summary of my findings:

## Key Findings

**The trend has shifted dramatically from record selling to volatile two-way flows.**

**First Half 2026 (record selling):**
- Foreign investors net-sold ~**148.3 trillion won** on KOSPI in H1 2026 (a record), concentrated in Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix
- June alone: ~**−48.6 trillion won**; May: ~**−44.7 trillion won**
- Driven by won weakness and profit-taking after the KOSPI's ~101% surge

**Turning point — June 12, 2026:**
- Foreigners net-bought ~**1.7 trillion won**, their first net buying in **25 trading days**, sparking a >8% intraday rally

**July 2026 (highly volatile weekly flows):**
- Month-to-date through ~July 16: net selling of ~**12.1 trillion won**
- **Week of July 20–24 (the latest week):**
  - July 22: **+3.51 trillion won** (5-session cumulative >5 trillion won)
  - July 23: **+2.15 trillion won** — KOSPI reclaimed 7,000
  - **July 24 (latest data point): −3.28 trillion won**, the largest single-day sell-off in 22 sessions, ending a four-day buying streak

**Bottom line:** Since mid-June, weekly foreign flows have swung sharply between multi-trillion-won net buying and net selling. The most recent reading (July 24) was a large net sale of 3.28 trillion won, though analysts at IBK and Hana suggested the record selling streak may be nearing an end.

*Note: I could not find data specifically labeled "June 2026 weekly latest" as a standalone weekly aggregate — Korea Exchange reports daily/session-based figures, so weekly figures here are reconstructed from daily and multi-session cumulative reporting. Dollar equivalents vary by source ($95B–$108.5B for H1) due to the weak won (~1,480+ USD/KRW).*

key_facts: Foreign investors were net sellers of ~148.3 trillion won (some sources ~149.04 trillion) on the KOSPI in H1 2026 — a record, roughly $95B-$106.8B.
H1 2026 foreign selling was concentrated in Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix; Samsung foreign ownership fell to a 16-year low.
Monthly H1 2026: May net selling ~44.71 trillion won; June net selling ~48.62 trillion won; a record single-day sell of 7.73 trillion won occurred in late June.
On June 12, 2026, foreigners net-bought ~1.7 trillion won on KOSPI — first net buying in 25 trading days — triggering a >8% intraday rally.
July 2026 month-to-date through ~July 16 (Thursday): foreigners net sold ~12.1 trillion won ($8.12B) on KOSPI, net sellers in 8 of 12 sessions; net bought ETFs +593.7 billion won.
July 22, 2026: foreign net buying of 3.5147 trillion won; five-session cumulative through July 22 exceeded 5 trillion won.
July 23, 2026: foreign net buying ~2.15 trillion won; KOSPI jumped 4.40% to 7,096.89, reclaiming 7,000 for the first time in ~6 sessions.
July 24, 2026: foreign net SELLING of 3.28 trillion won ($2.2B), the largest single-day sell-off in 22 trading days (since July 2), ending a four-day buying streak; KOSPI fell below 6,700.
Drivers of selling: won weakness (USD/KRW ~1,480+), profit-taking and rebalancing after ~101% KOSPI surge, dollar strength.
Analysts (IBK, Hana Securities) suggested record foreign selling may be nearing an end and anticipated a late-July rebound, though weekly flows remained highly volatile.
